title: Shader uniforms written in CSS only
blurb: Twelve cards drawn through one fragment shader whose uniforms are registered custom properties. Each card shows the editable CSS rule that drives it: transitions, keyframes, typed attr(), sibling-index(), random(), if(), style queries, progress(), @function and a view timeline.
question: Can a page drive every uniform of a canvas shader from CSS alone, and what does the canvas have to do to notice a change?
result: Every feature tried resolves to a number or colour in getComputedStyle(), including values in the middle of a transition or a view timeline. A custom property change raises no paint event, so the canvas reads the values once a frame; that read took about 0.1 ms for 12 cards.
